dropped-inner-join.doc: Returns the account even when its favourite category has no banner row.

forgot-lower-name.doc: Matches the search pattern against the stored name, forgetting lower(name).

literal-underscore.doc: Treats LIKE's `_` as a literal character rather than "any one character".

unsorted-history.doc:
Drops ORDER BY ORDERDATE. On a real MongoDB the (username, orderDate) index
hides this mistake, because an index scan returns rows in date order anyway,
until the planner picks another plan. The natural-order hint plays that plan
out, so the mistake is visible on every backend.

inventory-increment.doc: Adds the ordered quantity to stock instead of subtracting it.

statusless-orders.doc: Returns orders that have no status, which the legacy inner join hides.
